title: Ana majnoon al husain
body:
Ana majnoon al husain
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya aba abdillah..(2)
<<MINI>>
assalam alaika ya aba abdillah
majnoon al husain..(4)
ana majnoon al hussian..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
deewana e hussain hu
<<MINI>>
ana majnoon al hussian
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir ka mai hu deewana..(2)
aa maut mujhe seene se laga
<<MINI>>
ana majnoon al hussian..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Chehre ki siyahi noor bani
maqtal ki taraf jab jaun chala
aur aakhri lamhe me paaya
shabbir ke zaanu ka takiya..(2)
aaram mila jab dard utha..(2)
har zakhm ne milkar di ye sadaa
<<MINI>>
ana majnoon al hussian..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Shabbir ke daste qudrat me
eesa se zeyada qudrat hai
hatho ka hunar fir kya hoga
gehware me jab ye taaqat hai..(2)
fitrus ne jo baalo par paaye..(2)
jhoole se lipat kar kehne laga
<<MINI>>
ana majnoon al hussian..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Sar kab se rakha hai sajde me
tasbeeh ki kya tadaat hui
sajde me rasool e akram ko
thi fikr kaha in baato ki..(2)
jab tak ke nawasa pusht pe tha..(2)
kehta raha dil payghambar ka
<<MINI>>
ana majnoon al hussian..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jo maa ne sabaq samjhaya tha
har daur me usko yaad raha
abbas yahi dohrata hua
bachpan se jawani tak aaya..(2)
ghaazi ki zuba me kehta hai..(2)
ab tak ye alam lehrata hua
<<MINI>>
ana majnoon al hussian..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Hum karbobala ke deewane
jab taziya lekar chalte hai
aashoor ke din bhukhe pyase
mazloom ka matam karte hai..(2)
gir gir ke sadae deta hai..(2)
behte hue khoo ka har qatra
<<MINI>>
ana majnoon al hussian..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tewar ye batate the uske
ae baniye shar ek teer hai kya
mai dhaal hu apne baba ki
lashkar ke tu saare teer chala..(2)
asghar ne tabassum ki surat..(2)
maqtal me rajas bas itna padha
<<MINI>>
ana majnoon al hussian..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Pohcha jo dar e shabbir pe wo
marzi e shahe abraar mili
rumal e batool ki surat me
anmol use dastaar mili..(2)
ye faiz hai us ek jumle ka..(2)
jo hurr ne bawaqt e fajr kaha
<<MINI>>
ana majnoon al hussian..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Gar aaj khuda ki janib se
kaabe ko ijazat miljae
makke ki zamee ko chhod ke wo
khud karbobala me a pohche..(2)
har waqt husain ke roze ka..(2)
ye padh ke tawaaf kare kaaba
<<MINI>>
ana majnoon al hussian..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Socho to sahi ae meer hasan
lamhe wo bhala kese honge
jab bazm e imam e mehdi me
tum sher padhoge akbar ke..(2)
aur saath tumhare mehfil me..(2)
har shakhs yahi kehta hoga
<<MINI>>
ana majnoon al hussian..(2)
assalam alaika ya aba abdillah..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
author: Mir Hassan Mir
